concerns.text: Task T021a integrates streaming utilities into `materials_project.py` and `nist_repo.py` before those fetcher scripts are created (T012, T013, T013b). This consumer‑before‑producer ordering violates the dependency chain.
Task T024 adds OCR fallback integration into the streaming pipeline, but the OCR module (`src/ingest/ocr_extractor.py`) is only created later (T014c). Consumer precedes producer.
Task T060 validates the NIST endpoint in `src/ingest/nist_repo.py` before the NIST fetcher script is generated (T013). Ordering is incorrect.

Task T061 inserts "REAL DATA ONLY" comment blocks into fetcher files that are not yet present (materials_project.py, nist_repo.py, arxiv_extractor.py). Producer tasks (T012, T013, T013b) should precede this.
The fetcher creation tasks (T012, T013, T013b) are placed after tasks that depend on them (T021a, T060, T061, T024). Reorder to ensure fetcher scripts are produced first.
Task identifier T021b duplicates the base ID T021 used earlier for streaming integration (T021a). Duplicate IDs cause traceability ambiguity; assign a unique ID (e.g., T021c).

Task T023 scans `src/ingest/*.py` for synthetic data calls, but at this point many ingest scripts (e.g., fetchers) have not yet been created, making the scan ineffective. Move T023 after fetcher creation.
Task T014c (OCR fallback extraction) writes logs and never drops rows, but downstream tasks (e.g., T024) assume the OCR module exists. Ensure T014c runs before any task that references it.

Task T036 is marked completed (X) but depends on many upstream artifacts (metrics.csv, PDP PNGs, etc.) that may not yet exist if earlier ordering issues are unresolved. Verify that all producer tasks precede this aggregation step.
